chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام that he said:
"Indeed, in Khurāsān there is surely a spot over which a time will come when it will become a place frequented by the angels."
Then he said: "A group will continue descending from the heaven, and a group ascending, until the Trumpet is blown."
So it was said to him: "O son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, which spot is this?"

He said: "It is in the land of Ṭūs. By Allah, it is a garden from the gardens of Paradise. Whoever visits me in that spot is like one who has visited the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and Allah, Blessed and Exalted, writes for him the reward of one thousand accepted hajj and one thousand accepted ʿumrah, and I and my forefathers will be his intercessors on the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.الصُّورِ: The Trumpet that will be blown at the end of the world
key_terms.بِأَرْضِ طُوسَ: In the land of Tus; the location identified by the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.بِخُرَاسَانَ: In Khurasan; the region where the blessed spot is located
key_terms.رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ: A garden from the gardens of Paradise
key_terms.شُفَعَاءَهُ: His intercessors on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.مُخْتَلَفَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ: A place frequented by the angels

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of visiting Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام in Tus according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a blessed spot in Khurasan, identified as the land of Tus, which will be a place visited by angels until the blowing of the Trumpet. It highlights the immense merit of visiting Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام there, equating it with visiting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and promising great reward and shafa'ah on the Day of Resurrection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3193 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) that he said:
"Indeed, there is a spot in Khurasan where a time will come when it will become a place frequented by the angels."
Imam (as) continued: "A group will constantly descend from the heavens and a group will ascend, until the Trumpet is blown."
Imam was asked: "O son of the Messenger of Allah (swt), which spot is this?"

Imam (as) replied: "It is in the land of Tus. By Allah (swt), it is a garden from the gardens of Paradise. Whoever visits me in that spot will be as if they have visited the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family. Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, will write for them the reward of one thousand accepted Hajj and one thousand accepted Umrah. I and my forefathers will be their intercessors on the Day of Judgment."
